rules.inventory: Every executable package, app, client, workflow and operational surface discovered from the repository must have a matrix row.
rules.realEnvironment: An executable component without a registered real-environment assurance contract is BLOCKED, never PASS.
rules.evidence: A registered contract without independently observed evidence remains PENDING, never PASS.
rules.ciBoundary: CI/system assurance may prove deterministic repository execution but cannot substitute for production evidence.
rules.productionEvidence: Real production certification requires independently observed evidence tied to an immutable commit/artifact identity.
rules.phaseDocumentation: Phase documentation requirements are derived from docs/phases/README.md canonical records; historical and future unstarted phases are not mechanically required.
